meta.formula: blended_share = 0.5 * household_share + 0.5 * permit_share; if permit_share is null, blended_share = household_share; clamped to [0, 1.0] (no floor since 2026-11-04). Permit and household denominators use combined-region math for cross-county places. household_share = place ACS 5-year households / county ACS 5-year households, same period (owner decision 2026-11-03); a row whose household_inputs.period is 'mixed' still uses a 1-year figure because the 5-year count is not stored yet.
meta.small_place_rule: too_small is true below 250 ACS households: the series is kept, but the page shows no town figure and points to the county forecast. Shown figures are estimates rounded to tens.
